blocks.title: What this site is
blocks.text: A reference site of the archive. Applications, orders and payments are not handled here.

blocks.title: How the catalog works
blocks.text: Fund → inventory → case → document. A shelf mark like Ф.Д-1 Оп.1 Д.1 shows the path to a document.

blocks.title: How to search
blocks.text: Write in plain words: the site works out the document type, place and years.

blocks.title: Access statuses
blocks.text: “Open” — the copy can be viewed. “Restricted” and “Closed” — description only.

readingRoom.title: Reading room
readingRoom.text: Work with cases in the reading room happens during opening hours. Booking, ordering cases and filing applications through the site are not provided. The reading room rules will be published once approved by the archive.
readingRoom.contact: You can confirm the schedule by phoning the reception.

state.title: State service
state.lead: Reference information. Applications are not filed on this site: they are made on eGov.kz.

items.title: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan “On State Services”
Rules for providing state services in archival affairs (order of 29.05.2020 No. 159)

stepList: Choose the service on eGov.kz or e-Otinish.
Prepare the details: full name, period, organization, shelf mark if known.
File the application on the portal. The portal sets the deadline and result.
state.reports: Reports on services provided and conditions are published by the archive once approved.

paid.title: Paid services
paid.lead: Reference information. Ordering and payment are not available on this site.
paid.doc: Decree of the East Kazakhstan akimat No. 142 approving the price list of goods (works, services) sold by state archives.
paid.price: For the current price list and payment procedure, call the archive.

publications.title: Publications and photo gallery
publications.text: Document collections, essays and photographs of the archive. The section is being filled: materials will appear after approval.

symbols.title: State symbols
symbols.text: The flag, coat of arms and anthem of the Republic of Kazakhstan. Materials are on official resources.

items.title: Official site of the President of Kazakhstan

blocks.title: What we keep
blocks.text: For the account — your e-mail, name and the materials you saved. Search queries are recorded without a name or IP address and are used to improve search.

blocks.title: AI
blocks.text: The assistant runs on the archive's local model. Your questions are not sent to third-party services.

blocks.title: Your rights
blocks.text: You can delete your account and saved data in the account at any time.
